title: Runtime State Enums v0.1
description: State and stop-reason enums for deterministic agent state machine. M3.T0 artifact.

agent_state.description: Current agent loop state. Runtime-owned; model never mutates.

state_class.description: intermediate: has outgoing transitions. terminal: non-escaping.

stop_reason.description: Reason for entering a terminal state. Governance: explicit_refusal, boundary_block, authority_fail, boundary_crossed. Loop: budget_exhausted, iteration_limit, validation_failed, sandbox_error, test_failure, user_abort, timeout.
